topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Can you believe it? That old Mr. Thompson—lives alone, barely says hi, right? Turns out, he's sitting on a fortune! I saw his car the other day, looked super fancy under that dusty old cover. And then there's the talk about his house, how it's worth way more than anyone thought. My hands are all fidgety thinking about how we never knew, like, what’s behind those closed doors. It’s like living next to a mystery novel that’s just gotten a lot more interesting. I mean, I’ve always thought there was more to life than what we see, but this? This is something else. How do you even start a conversation with someone like that?
